steps.code:
# Fetch all 20 habit tracking notes and extract good posture status
access_token = login_response['access_token']
posture_days = []
for note_id in range(11, 31):
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
    # Extract date from title
    date_str = note['title'].replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '')
    # Parse content for practiced_good_posture
    content = note['content']
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
            status = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            posture_days.append((date_str, status))
            break
print(posture_days)

steps.code:
# Compute longest consecutive streak of "yes" for practiced_good_posture
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Convert to chronological order (oldest first)
posture_days_sorted = sorted(posture_days, key=lambda x: datetime.strptime(x[0], '%Y-%m-%d'))

max_streak = 0
current_streak = 0
for date_str, status in posture_days_sorted:
    if status == 'yes':
        current_streak += 1
        if current_streak > max_streak:
            max_streak = current_streak
    else:
        current_streak = 0

print(max_streak)
